title: Policy evaluation
description: The verdict of one versioned policy set over one run, produced by the policy-eval node.

summary.description: Counts by outcome, e.g. 'PASS:10 FAIL:0 EXC:1 NA:2'.

releaseBlocked.description: True when any mandatory rule failed. The node returns this as a failure, so the release gate is blocked by the engine's dependency rule rather than by a human noticing a field.

outcome.description: Closed by design (REQ-D-004). NOT_APPLICABLE is counted separately from PASS so it cannot inflate the pass total, and EXCEPTION_REQUESTED marks a gap a human must decide rather than a proven violation.
